name: St. Louis Spring 2025

venue.name: James J. Eagan Community Center
venue.address: 1 James J. Eagan Dr, Florissant, MO 63033
venue.details: Competition will be held in the main Gym past the front desk. Enter through the main entrance.

information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWxjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d1f52348f9e8749067367295f2008944d5ecb8df/image.png)

We have a local facebook group where we will be posting upcoming events as they are announced as well as supporting local cubing conversations for Missouri. Jump over and join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/share/g/E9e6wegXgD8B91Nx/) facebook group!

Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.

Please view the other tabs to get more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, you may want to look at CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTE3MjMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f0eddbc1f7f28b02cc85ea1cd03670055321616/St%20Louis%20Spring%202025%20Logo.jpg)
